title: Crossroad Springs
description: James returns to Chicago to officiate a wedding, but reuniting with his former fiancée stirs emotions he thought he'd left behind; at the same time, Daniel travels to Houston to investigate Jackson's mysterious past, uncovering clues that suggest the Newman patriarch has been hiding far more than anyone imagined.

title: Crossroad Springs
description: As Crossroad Springs faces a season of change, James wrestles with lingering feelings from his past, Daniel races to stop Jackson from tearing apart the Newman legacy and Maggie celebrates the successful launch of the community food pantry; with family members leaving town and futures pulling everyone in different directions, Willis finds himself wondering what lies ahead for the ranch he has spent his life building.

title: Heartland
description: Amy steps in to help Georgie with a new challenge.

title: Heartland
description: Amy and Georgie work to help a traumatized barrel-racing horse.

title: The PA and the Manhattan Prince
description: Loyal, quick-thinking Lucy Woods is a personal assistant to the stars, but when Prince Rupert arrives in New York to make preparations for a masked ball, Lucy finds herself falling in love with her new employer.

title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Winemaker
description: Former criminologist Ainsley McGregor returns to her hometown of Sweet River, Texas, to open a market for artisans to sell crafts and wares. However, when her friend is accused of murder, McGregor finds herself returning to her crime-solving ways.

title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Yarn Maker
description: Former criminologist Ainsley McGregor investigates the mysterious murder of a renowned yarn maker.

title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Watchmaker
description: Ainsley McGregor is enjoying small-town routines until murder disrupts again. When a respected local watchmaker is found dead, the close-knit community is shaken, and suspicion quickly spreads among friends, customers, and competitors.

title: Just the Way You Are
description: Hoping to recharge her marriage, a professional matchmaker asks her husband out on a blind date.

title: Another Sweet Christmas
description: When Sophie and Sam's picture-perfect love story is transformed into a Christmas movie, their hometown of Waynesbridge, Washington, becomes a dazzling holiday film set. But as the spotlight grows brighter, real-life challenges soon follow.

title: Timeless Tidings of Joy
description: Ally, inherits Timeless Tidings, a shop her grandmother, Joy, opened in the 1940s to sell her handmade letter-press tidings. The shop was a labor of love, service, and sacrifice throughout the decades for Joy. Ally always saw Joy's sacrifices for the shop as a burden on Joy's life and happiness. When Ally returns to the shop to prepare it for sale, she meets Bennett, an old soul, who wants to preserve her Grandma Joy's legacy.

title: Home Sweet Christmas
description: Sparks fly between a successful attorney and her childhood friend after they both inherit her late great-uncle's sprawling patch of sugar maple forest.

title: A Christmas Less Traveled
description: An old audio cassette of her dad's voice sends a woman on a journey to retrace her family's most memorable moments. Along the way, she meets a man who offers her a generous payment in exchange for a ride to close the most important deal of his life.

title: My Christmas Hero
description: An army reserve doctor tracks down her family's military history with the help of a new romance.

title: A Christmas... Present
description: Knowing that this is to be Paul's first Christmas alone with his daughter, Ashley, since his wife's passing, Maggie decides to bring Eric and the kids for a visit to spread some Christmas cheer.

title: Christmas Town
description: Lauren leaves everything behind in Boston to embark on a new chapter in her life and career. On an unforeseen detour to the town of Grandon Falls, she discovers love and family, helping her to embrace the magic of Christmas.

title: Blessings in Disguise
description: Katie, a driven New York fashion designer with only three weeks to develop a collection that could launch her brand to national prominence. Katie reconnects with Luke, her first love and now a gifted furniture designer and woodworker whose designs are rooted in craftmanship, patience, and purpose. As their lives intertwine once more, the two discover that inspiration is not found in deadlines or demand - but in the timeless values of home, heritage, and hope.

title: Dream Wedding
description: When sisters Megan and Kate attend a local wedding fair, they jokingly enter for a dream wedding package, even though neither is getting married; the sisters win, and now must put on a show or be mortified by their champagne decisions.

title: Unexpected Grace
description: Trying to find her place in a new town, Grace discovers a note from a schoolgirl looking for a friend. She writes back and sets off a chain of events that ultimately changes the lives of three people.

title: Love in Focus
description: Jenna, after finding out her hit show has been canceled, retreats to a mountain cabin where, due to a mix-up, she must share it with a handsome nature photographer. After initially colliding, they make the most of it and end up falling in love.

title: A Christmas Miracle for Daisy
description: Interior designer Whitney Alder agrees to work for her ex-boyfriend Cormac, who has adopted his orphaned niece, Daisy. Daisy's Christmas wish is for Whitney and Cormac to get together so she can have the mother she always wanted.

title: Operation Mistletoe
description: When Grace's former crush comes home for Christmas, her best friend tries to play matchmaker by hiring her to decorate the house he plans to sell.

title: A Merry Christmas Wish
description: An NYC advertising executive returns to her hometown to sell the family farm but instead reconnects with her childhood friend and gets involved with organizing the yearly Winter Wonderland, which takes place on the property.

title: A Royal Date for Christmas
description: When a European Duke arrives in the US, he realizes that his bags have been lost in transit; he has no choice but to be styled, and ultimately inspired, by Bella, the owner of a local boutique.

title: Toying With the Holidays
description: A workaholic single mom returns to her hometown determined to introduce her young son to some beloved holiday traditions. While there, she reconnects with a former classmate, now a model train hobbyist.
